rows.name: Nebraska Real Estate Commission
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Nebraska's real estate brokers and salespersons. Six members appointed by the Governor — three district brokers plus a public member, a salesperson, and an at-large broker (Neb. Rev. Stat. 81-885.02).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Nebraska Statutes; NE publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Nebraska Game and Parks Commission
rows.mandate: Sets policy for Nebraska's wildlife, fisheries, and state parks. Nine commissioners appointed by the Governor with legislative consent — one from each of eight districts plus one at large (Neb. Rev. Stat. 37-101).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Nebraska Statutes; NE publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Nebraska Power Review Board
rows.mandate: Regulates the structure of Nebraska's public-power system and approves major electric projects. Five members appointed by the Governor — at least one engineer and one attorney (Neb. Rev. Stat. 70-1003).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Nebraska Statutes; NE publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
